We did the voodoo, vampire, witches tour. We had Edward as our guide. He was awesome! Friendly and informative. We checked in 10 min before start time. I think arriving 30 min prior is too long. We stopped at 4 places and he talked about the history and stories. Some of the stories were frightening. In the middle we stopped at a bar if we needed to us the restroom. I noticed towards the end of the tour our group got smaller, oh well. Overall, great tour and experience.

text.text_excerpt: My friends and I recently got home from a week in New Orleans. While there we did two tours with Witches Brew. One night we did the adults only Voodoo Ghost Tour. Jennifer was our guide and she was amazing. She made the tour fun and she knew tons of interesting facts and information about the city and it's past. We learned a lot about the spooky history of the city and got to hear stories about ghosts, voodoo, vampires, and all the creepy things that have happened in the city. This tour was great and highly recommended. Another day we did the St. Louis Cemetery #1 Tour. Trevor was our guide and did an outstanding job, especially considering the circumstances. Woo! What a fun tour. I went on the 4-in-1 tour through a Groupon that included tales of voodoo, vampires, witches, and ghosts. Our tour guide Ryan was an incredibly captivating storyteller, so much so that I was totally spooked out and couldn't sleep that night! This was honestly one of those experiences that I know I'll remember for the rest of my life, as well as how much fun I had hanging out and getting scared with my friends. Definitely grab a drink before, and during the break because that just makes it all the more fun.

We did the voodoo, vampire, witches tour. We had Edward as our guide. He was awesome! Friendly and informative. We checked in 10 min before start time. I think arriving 30 min prior is too long. We stopped at 4 places and he talked about the history and stories. Some of the stories were frightening. In the middle we stopped at a bar if we needed to us the restroom. I noticed towards the end of the tour our group got smaller, oh well. Overall, great tour and experience.
